page.layout: One printed page, full width: ornamental border at top, dedication title block, signature line at lower right; a stamp and shelf mark on the lower left (not transcribed). Right edge shows the neighbouring page (show-through/edge, not transcribed except nothing). No page number, no running head.

main_text.head: Illustri, atque Generosissimo Domino, D N. RABAN DE CANSTEIN, Serenissimo Electori Brandenburgico ab intimis Status consiliiis, Supremo aulæ Præfecto, Cameræ Electoralis summo Præsidi, Præfecturæ Hornburgensis, Bescoviana, Zedenicensis & Libenwaldensis Capitaneo, Domino in Canstein, Lindenberg & Mallenich, PATRONO MAXIMO
main_text.p: Libellum hunc L. M. Q. D. C. Cliens humillime devotus Mart. Schoockius

page.notes: Transcription of the title block. The stamp "Herzog August Bibliothek Wolfenbüttel" and the handwritten shelf mark "X64353" are not transcribed. The printed line "Libenwaldensis" reads as printed; the printed "Bescoviana" and "Zedenicensis" are as shown. The signature line "Mart. Schoockius" is set at the right and the dedication line "Libellum hunc..." is set in bold type at right, placed below the title block. Right-edge text of the neighbouring page is not transcribed.
